environment.description: Same Actix-web service deployed on ECS Fargate behind an internal ALB. The PostgreSQL connection uses role 'webhook_reader' which was provisioned via Terraform with a narrowly-scoped GRANT: only SELECT privilege on the webhooks table within the 'app' schema, with no privileges on any other schema or table, and the role has NOSUPERUSER NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE attributes. The pg_hba.conf enforces this role mapping for connections from the ECS task subnet CIDR. Note: the SSRF vector in register_webhook() still allows outbound HTTP requests to arbitrary URLs including internal metadata endpoints; the database restriction only limits persistence of malicious webhook URLs.

config.database_role_sql: CREATE ROLE webhook_reader WITH LOGIN NOSUPERUSER NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE PASSWORD 'rotated-via-secrets-manager'; GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA app TO webhook_reader; GRANT SELECT ON app.webhooks TO webhook_reader; -- No INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE granted
config.network_note: ECS task security group allows egress to 0.0.0.0/0 on ports 443,80; no IMDSv1 (Fargate has no instance metadata endpoint)
